claims.text: What the image looks like Hyperinflation, flat diaphragms, ↑ AP diameter → COPD / emphysema
claims.quote: Hyperinflation, flat diaphragms, ↑ AP diameter COPD / emphysema
claims.locator: Chest X-Ray (CXR), Chronic / Diffuse Lung Disease table

claims.text: Aspects (abnormal in red) Inspiration check: ≥9-10 posterior or 5-6 anterior ribs above the diaphragm
claims.quote: Inspiration (≥9-10 posterior or 5-6 anterior ribs above diaphragm)
claims.locator: Chest X-Ray (CXR), Reading Approach (RIPE technical adequacy → ABCDE-FGHI)

claims.text: Diaphragm check: R higher than L by ~1-2 cm; sharp costophrenic angles
claims.quote: D - Diaphragm: R higher than L by ~1-2 cm; sharp costophrenic angles; free air under diaphragm = perforation.
claims.locator: Chest X-Ray (CXR), Reading Approach (RIPE technical adequacy → ABCDE-FGHI)

claims.text: Chest imaging sometimes shows lung hyperinflation, bullae, increased retrosternal air space and/or bronchial wall thickening; imaging is usually not diagnostically helpful and is done mainly to exclude other disorders
claims.quote: Sometimes lung hyperinflation, bullae, increased retrosternal air space, and/or bronchial wall thickening (seen on chest imaging); however, imaging is usually not helpful diagnostically and is done mainly to exclude other disorders

claims.text: Bullae are airspaces ≥ 1 cm in diameter formed when enlarged alveolar spaces consolidate; they occasionally occupy an entire hemithorax
claims.quote: Enlarged alveolar spaces sometimes consolidate into bullae, defined as airspaces ≥ 1 cm in diameter. Bullae may be entirely empty or have strands of lung tissue traversing them in areas of locally severe emphysema; they occasionally occupy an entire hemithorax.

claims.text: Causes Airflow limitation caused by an inflammatory response to inhaled toxins, often cigarette smoke; alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency and various occupational exposures are less common causes in people who do not smoke
claims.quote: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is airflow limitation caused by an inflammatory response to inhaled toxins, often cigarette smoke. Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency and various occupational exposures are less common causes in patients who do not smoke.

claims.text: Emphysema: destruction of lung parenchyma → loss of elastic recoil, loss of alveolar septa and radial airway traction, which increases the tendency for airway collapse; lung hyperinflation, airflow limitation and air trapping follow
claims.quote: Emphysema is destruction of lung parenchyma leading to a loss of elastic recoil, loss of alveolar septa, and radial airway traction, which increases the tendency for airway collapse. Lung hyperinflation, airflow limitation, and air trapping follow.

claims.text: Symptoms Productive cough is the initial symptom, typically in people who smoke and are in their 40s and 50s; dyspnea that is progressive, persistent, exertional, or worse during respiratory infection appears in the late 50s or 60s
claims.quote: Productive cough is the initial symptom, typically developing among people who smoke and are in their 40s and 50s. Dyspnea that is progressive, persistent, exertional, or worse during respiratory infection appears when patients are in their late 50s or 60s.

claims.text: Signs: wheezing, a prolonged expiratory phase, lung hyperinflation (decreased heart and lung sounds) and increased anteroposterior diameter of the thorax (barrel chest)
claims.quote: Signs of COPD include wheezing, a prolonged expiratory phase of breathing, lung hyperinflation manifested as decreased heart and lung sounds, and increased anteroposterior diameter of the thorax (barrel chest).

claims.text: Treatment and next step Her chart: bronchodilators, smoking cessation
claims.locator: Chest X-Ray (CXR), Chronic / Diffuse Lung Disease table

claims.text: Diagnosis: post-bronchodilator reductions of FEV1, FVC and FEV1/FVC (fixed obstruction) are characteristic
claims.quote: Reductions of FEV1, FVC, and the ratio of FEV1/FVC post-bronchodilator (also called fixed obstruction) are characteristic findings.

claims.text: Acute symptoms are treated primarily with short-acting beta-adrenergic medications
claims.quote: Treatment of acute symptoms is primarily with short-acting beta-adrenergic medications.

claims.text: Encourage smoking cessation, using multiple interventions, in all patients who smoke
claims.quote: Smoking cessation using multiple interventions should be encouraged in all patients who smoke.
